Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Valor Soren: 30-year-old woman, 160 cm (short), plus-size heavy construction with substantial natural mass, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: round full face; small bright eyes and fine straight brows; long straight nose, narrow upper lip; faint freckles. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: brown-chestnut, shaved-close-cropped, deliberate accent: sculpted edge pattern. Wardrobe: layered-wrap, specifically overlapping wrap panels, an off-center waist tie, divided trousers, and soft boots; a high soft collar and uneven layered hems; bounded palette marigold-green. Visible personal details: a compact finger-line tattoo family; a hand-painted hem mark. Make a tattoo, scar, freckle field, or birthmark the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: practical grooming with one carefully perfected detail. Color treatment: lets faded and repaired areas vary the palette. Pose cue: one thumb hooks lightly beneath the waist wrap while the other hand rests open. Include a blunt carpenter's chalk only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
